description: This file defines a React component named 'QuizPage' that renders a quiz interface for a given video ID. It fetches questions from an API, displays them, allows users to answer, and then submits the answers to receive a score and percentage result. It manages loading, error states, and displays the results after submission.

methods.name: setAnswer
methods.description: Updates the answers state with a new answer for a specific question ID.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles submission of quiz answers to the server, updates the result state with the response or error.
